answer.summary: To register your shop in Uttar Pradesh under the UP Shops and Establishment Act 1962, you must submit your application through the official state single-window portal. The Labour Department handles this registration process online.
steps: Visit the official Uttar Pradesh Nivesh Mitra single-window portal at https://niveshmitra.up.nic.in/.
Navigate to the application section for the Registration under UP Shops and Establishment Act 1962 under the Labour Department.
Follow the official user process flow linked on the portal to fill out your application form.
Enter all required shop and establishment details accurately into the online form.
Review the official service checklist for any required documents and attach them to your digital application.
Submit your application and any calculated fees directly through the Niveshmitra portal.
Alternatively, you may approach the departmental or statutory-authority jurisdiction in Uttar Pradesh for offline submissions if applicable.
Track your application status online through the portal until approval.
required_documents: NOT PUBLISHED BY THE OFFICIAL SOURCE (Please check the official service checklist on the Nivesh Mitra portal to confirm required documents)
answer.fees: Variable Fee (Auto calculated based on inputs)
tips: The exact registration fee is auto-calculated by the portal based on your specific inputs, such as the number of employees or establishment type.
